_about: Streak nights taken in any order (CLAUDE.md 48b, save v39), pinned on both sides.
Each case is a run of play and taps; `claims` is the [day, night] the client dates each tap's
claim under. Assets/Game/Tests/StreakTests.cs derives `claims` from the real ledger rules
(DailyStreak.Advance, SeedCollected, Collect, StreakTaken) and must reproduce them exactly;
firebase/functions/test/reward-vectors.mjs replays them through the real `advances` and
`raise` from functions/src/streak.ts, in the order tapped and in the day-sorted order
claimAwards batches them in, and every one must be paid.
Hand-written: a case is a scenario, not a generated table. `serverFloor` is what a fresh
wallet holds (readWallet seeds it to the day before the run). Shields cover `shieldDays`.

streakOrderCases.name: newest first, then a shield slides the run, then the rest in a scramble
a shield before the run's first claim, then newest first
a broken streak starts a new run on a new line
